history.overview: The Trial of Efficiency tests combatants’ ability to act with speed, precision, and minimal waste under Discord pressure.

timeline.name: Efficiency Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a trial focused on precision and optimization.

timeline.name: Timed Mechanisms
timeline.description: Timed platforms and shifting lanes were added to test reaction speed.

timeline.name: Dragorn Efficiency Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into rapid‑response scenarios.

timeline.name: Discord Drain Integration
timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to punish inefficiency with stamina drain.
